blocks.text: Expression system se muraad aisa munasib jandar hai jo rDNA (vector ke saath jura gene of interest) ka host ban sake aur gene of interest ko express kar sake, yaani us gene se protein bana sake. Munasib expression system ka intikhab is baat par hai ke rDNA banane ke liye kaun sa vector istemal hua. Bacterial cells behtareen expression system hain kyun ke un ki generation time (nayi nasl banne ka waqt) chhota hai aur un ka genetic system saada hai.

blocks.prompt: Gene of interest aur plasmid dono ko aik hi restriction enzyme se kyun kaata jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taa ke dono par aik jaise, aapas mein milne wale (complementary) sticky ends banein. Yeh sire aapas mein jur jate hain aur phir DNA ligase phosphodiester bonds bana kar inhein pakka jor deta hai.

items: Gene of interest: lab mein seedha banaya jaye, mRNA se reverse transcription se banaya jaye, ya restriction endonuclease se chromosome se kaata jaye.
Restriction endonucleases (molecular scissors) 4 se 8 nucleotides ki palindromic sites pehchan kar kaat'te hain aur sticky ends chhorte hain.
Vectors (zyada tar plasmids; phages, cosmids, BACs, YACs, P1 chromosomes, animal viruses) gene ko host cell tak le jate hain.
DNA ligase (molecular glue) phosphodiester linkage banata hai; bacteria behtareen expression system hain.
